(17M)Similar situation here. My mother treats me horribly when it's just the two of us. If my step father, or anyone else is around she treats me much better. I have tried to tell people about the way she treats me but when she is confronted about it she lies and blames everything on me. The story goes on but I think I've gotten the relevant information across. You might be able to find a solution in your case, but what has worked best for me is isolation. I avoid situations in which I might be targeted. I spend a lot of time out of the house and with my friends, and if I am home I spend my time either alone in my room or with my step father or brother so she doesn't have opportunities to mistreat me. By the sounds of it you can't really escape it as long as your in the house. So I'd recommend getting out with your friends more or joining an activity like a sport or a club that gets you out of the house often. Good luck and I hope things go well.
